title: Deconfliction line used before strike on Russian proxies in Syria

tellings.quote: Russians through their proxies uh proxy militias attacked a bunch of Americans in Syria and we called them on the deconfliction line

plain: After militias working for Russia attacked a group of Americans in Syria, the story goes, the US called the Russians on the deconfliction line, a direct channel the two militaries use to avoid accidental clashes, before striking back. Bob Maguire, a former CIA contractor, tells Michels this as something he was told. It shows how the two powers warned each other even while fighting through others.
